title: Combine Dsw Plan
desc: A personal utility for combining study plans from separate sources. Uses web scraping to gather data from two plans and combines them into a single, unified plan.

title: FastAPI To-Do List
desc: A simple to-do list application built with FastAPI and React. Has a SQLite database for storing tasks and a RESTful API for managing them.
